name: Tools & Technology
description: Material inventions and learned processes that changed prehistoric survival.
episode_objects: a stone core with refitted flakes
a resin adhesive on a hafted point
time_place_scopes: a workshop floor beside a hearth
a seasonal hunting and processing camp
mechanisms: sequenced material transformation and skill transmission
tool design matched to a recurring ecological problem
evidence_lenses: chaîne opératoire reconstruction and dated context
exclusions: Do not portray prehistoric technology as primitive failure or inevitable progress.
Do not claim an exact procedure where evidence supports only a constrained reconstruction.
prompt_context: Follow an evidence-backed material process from constraint through tested reconstruction and trade-off; do not portray ancient technology as a crude precursor to modernity.
